full_name: Lisa McGirr | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2012–2013 History ACLS Frederick Burkhardt Fellow Harvard University
bio: Lisa McGirr is a professor at Harvard University specializing in the history of the United States in the 20th century. Her research bridges the fields of social and political history and focuses in particular on collective action, political culture, reform movements, and political ideology.
